blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.
blocks.zh: 流式视频大语言模型(VLMs)使得视频能够持续理解,然而现有的基准侧重于低动态情景. 在限定的上下文预算下,模型必须平衡时间历史、空间分辨率和时间颗粒性;1-2-FPS的零星采样错过了快速事件。 我们介绍Fast Bench来评估现实世界视频流中高动力感知. 它的轨迹定位管道结合了高FPS剪辑的QA生成,在2 FPS过滤问题答案,使用SAM3和CoTracker3轨迹进行解答验证,以及三轮人类检查. Fast Bench包含跨8个域的306个QA对,6个容量,以及前,即时,落后的时间范围,并带有人附加说明的证据间隔. 我们还提出 " 主动Frame " ,这是一个无培训基线,通过文本符号调整收到的帧率。 双层滑动窗口保留了最近的高FPS观测数据,同时将较老的观测数据降为稀疏的历史。 实验揭示了实质性的局限性:最强的模型双子座3.5-Flash,得分只有50.7%. Denser采样改进了Qwen3-VL-8B,从2 FPS的32.9%提高到24 FPS的44.6%,但随着历史的压缩而增饱和. 主动 框架比稀有的统一取样多5.4和1.5个百分点,但仍远远低于oracle指导重点,表明当需要更精确的时间感知时,目前的VLM就难以从溪流中确定。 Fast Bench为高动力流视频理解提供了测试台. 代码和数据:https://github.com/Ashone3/Fast Bench.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The remarkable success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has catalyzed significant progress in the domain of video understanding. Recent advancements in Video VLMs, such as VideoChat ( Li et al., 2025a ) and LLaVA-NeXT-Video ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , have demonstrated impressive capabilities in comprehending temporally bounded, offline video clips. However, real-world applications often require interacting with continuous, infinite visual inputs on the fly. This necessity has driven a recent paradigm shift towards Streaming Video Large Language Models (Streaming VLMs), which are designed to process newly arriving visual streams in real time and maintain long-term context, as exemplified by StreamingVLM ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)和Vision-Language Models(VLMs)的显著成功催生了视频理解领域的显著进展. 视频 VLM 等最新进展 Chat(Li等,2025年a)和LLaVA-NEXT-Video(Zhang等,2024年)在理解有时间限制的离线视频片段方面表现出了令人印象深刻的能力。 然而,现实世界的应用往往需要与苍蝇上持续,无限的视觉输入进行互动. 这一必要性推动了最近向流式视频大语言模型(Streaming VLMs)的范式转变,这些模型旨在实时处理新到的视觉流并保持长期背景,StreamingVLM(Xu等,2026年)就是例证.

blocks.en: Despite this rapid progress, existing streaming evaluation benchmarks, such as OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) and PhoStream ( Lu et al., 2026b ) , emphasize temporal reasoning and response timing without explicitly targeting high-dynamic perception. This leaves a critical challenge encountered in real-world streaming applications: accurately perceiving and comprehending highly dynamic, fast-paced events under strict context window constraints. In practice, video streams exhibit a heterogeneous mixture of low- and high-dynamic scenes. Operating under limited token budgets, current models must balance the need for maintaining a long temporal history, preserving high spatial resolution, and capturing fine-grained temporal information. Such constraints motivate sparse frame sampling; for example, the online baselines evaluated in OVO-Bench operate at 1–2 frames per second ( Niu et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, when faced with rapidly changing high-frequency actions—such as sports, extreme gaming, or wildlife hunting—these models often miss crucial visual details, leading to severe perception failures (as illustrated in Fig. 1 ). While recent studies have introduced offline benchmarks focusing on motion comprehension and high frame-per-second (FPS) perception (e.g., MotionBench, Hong et al., 2025 ; FPS-Bench, Choudhury et al., 2026 ), evaluating the capability to perceive high-dynamic events within a continuous, untrimmed streaming context remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了如此快的进展,但OVO-Bench(Niu等,2025年)和PhoStream(Lu等,2026年b)等现有的流评价基准强调时间推理和反应时间,而没有明确地针对高动力感知. 这就留下了现实世界流式应用中遇到的关键性挑战:在严格的上下文窗口限制下,精确地理解和理解高度动态的快节奏事件. 在实践中,视频流呈现出一种由低能动和高能动的场景所混合而成的多样化. 在有限的象征性预算下运作,目前的模型必须平衡保持长期历史、保持高空间分辨率和捕捉精细的时间信息的需要。 这种限制促使采样框架很少;例如,OVO-Bench公司评估的在线基线每秒运行1至2个框架(Niu等人,2025年)。 因此,在面临迅速变化的高频行动——例如体育、极端游戏或野生生物狩猎——时,这些模型往往忽略关键的视觉细节,导致严重的认知失败(如图1所示)。 最近的研究采用了离线基准,侧重于运动理解和高帧每秒(FPS)感知(如:Motion Bench, Hong等,2025;FPS-Bench, Choudhury等,2026),但评价在一个连续的、未调整的流畅背景下感知高动态事件的能力仍然是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: Figure 1: A perception failure in a high-dynamic video event. A wooden separator (highlighted in purple using SAM 3) is removed, allowing the metal rods to touch and produce sparks. Both models provide generic electrical explanations that could be inferred from the sparks alone, but fail to identify the brief sequence of separator removal and subsequent contact that triggers the discharge. This illustrates the challenge of capturing critical visual details in fast-paced events.
blocks.zh: 图1:高动态视频事件中的感知失败. 取出一个木质分隔器(高亮于紫色使用SAM 3),使金属棒可以触摸并产生火花. 两种型号都提供了一般的电气解释,仅从火花中就可以推断出,但未能识别引发放电的分离器去除和后续接触的短暂序列. 这表明在快节奏事件中捕捉关键视觉细节的挑战。

blocks.en: To bridge this critical gap, we introduce FastBench, a novel benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the performance of streaming VLMs on high-dynamic real-world video streams. FastBench is constructed via a meticulously designed pipeline that synergizes VLM-driven generation, agentic expert verification, and rigorous human inspection. To ensure true temporal dependency, we introduce a low-FPS verification step that proactively filters out pseudo-dynamic questions. Furthermore, to overcome the inherent hallucination risks of VLMs in fast-paced scenarios, we propose a novel Vision Expert Verification mechanism. By autonomously invoking vision foundation models, the VLM verifies and refines its QA pairs against objective, text-based physical trajectories rather than error-prone visual features. Spanning diverse domains including sports, gaming, nature, and traffic, FastBench establishes a stringent evaluation standard for high-dynamic streaming perception.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一关键差距,我们引入了"快奔驰"(Fast Bench),这是一个专门用来评价流出VLM在高动态现实世界视频流上的性能的新基准. Fast Bench是通过精心设计的管道建造的,该管道协同VLM驱动的生成,代理专家的核查,以及严格的人类检查. 为了确保真正的时间依赖性,我们引入了低速感系统核查步骤,主动过滤出伪动态问题。 此外,为了克服在速度快的假想中VLM的内在幻觉风险,我们提议建立一个新的Vision专家核查机制。 通过自主地引用视觉基础模型,VLM对照客观的,以文字为基础的物理轨迹而不是容易出错的视觉特征,验证并完善了自己的QA对. Fast Bench为高动力流感设定了严格的评价标准。

blocks.en: Along with the benchmark, we present ProactiveFrame, a simple, training-free baseline framework. Diverging from passive uniform sampling, ProactiveFrame empowers the agent to dynamically adjust its temporal perception granularity via text prompts based on the ongoing streaming context. To balance the need for fine-grained perception and long-term memory under strict token budgets, we introduce a dual-tier context sliding window mechanism. Operating on a single, unified chronological stream, this design proactively buffers high-FPS chunks for fleeting events, which subsequently undergo a graceful temporal degradation into a sparse historical context. This hierarchical management elegantly resolves the trade-off, enabling continuous high-dynamic perception without fragmenting the temporal horizon. Evaluations on FastBench show that high-dynamic perception benefits from denser temporal sampling, but remains constrained by the trade-off between temporal granularity and historical context. ProactiveFrame improves over sparse uniform sampling, yet its gap to oracle-guided sampling highlights the challenge of autonomously identifying when finer temporal perception is needed.
blocks.zh: 与基准一起,我们提出了 " 积极主动的Frame " ,这是一个简单、无培训的基线框架。 与被动统一采样不同,主动Frame授权代理人通过文本提示,根据进行中流环境,动态地调整其时间感知颗粒性. 为了在严格的象征性预算下平衡对精细感知和长期记忆的需要,我们引入了双层背景滑动窗口机制. 这种设计在单一、统一的时序流上运行,主动地缓冲出为一瞬间事件而设的高FPS块,随后在短暂的历史背景下发生了优雅的时间退化。 这种分级管理优雅地解决了取舍问题,使得能够持续地高动力感知而不会分解出时间范围. 对快奔驰的评价表明,高能动感知从更密集的时间采样中获益,但仍受到时间颗粒性和历史背景取舍的限制. 主动 框架改进了稀有的统一抽样,但其与甲骨文指导抽样的差距突出表明,在何时需要更精确的时间感知时必须自主确定。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are three-fold: • High-Dynamic Streaming Benchmark: We introduce FastBench , a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate high-frame-rate-dependent perception in continuous video streams under bounded-context and response-timing constraints • Trajectory-Grounded Data Pipeline: We propose an innovative data construction pipeline incorporating a low-FPS filtering mechanism to remove pseudo-dynamic questions, paired with a Vision Expert Verification module that grounds VLM annotations on objective physical trajectories to mitigate visual hallucinations. • Training-Free Baseline Framework: We present ProactiveFrame , a simple yet effective training-free framework that features a dual-tier context sliding window mechanism. It dynamically buffers high-FPS chunks for fleeting events and allows them to gracefully degrade into sparse historical context, balancing fine-grained perception and long-term memory under tight token budgets.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献有三: 基准: Fast Bench 是一个专门用来评估在有限度的文字和反应定时限制下连续视频流中高帧率依赖感的基准。 我们提议采用创新的数据构建管道,包括一个低频分解过滤机制,去除伪动力学问题,并配以远景专家核查模块,将VLM说明作为客观物理轨迹的依据,以缓解视觉幻觉。 • 无培训基线框架: 我们提出一个具有双层环境滑动窗口机制的简单而有效的无培训框架。 它能动态地缓冲用于一瞬间事件的高频频频段,使其能优雅地退化成稀少的历史背景,在紧凑的象征性预算下平衡精细的感想和长期记忆.

blocks.en: 2.1 Streaming Video Understanding Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.1 简化视频理解基准

blocks.en:
Streaming video benchmarks evaluate understanding from incrementally
available evidence. StreamingBench ( Lin et al., 2026 ) assesses real-time visual, omni-source, and contextual understanding,
while OVO-Bench ( Niu et al., 2025 ) covers backward tracing,
real-time understanding, and forward active responding.
OVBench ( Huang et al., 2025 ) evaluates online perception, memory,
and reasoning across past, present, and future contexts.
PhoStream ( Lu et al., 2026b ) extends evaluation to open-ended
question answering in mobile scenarios, emphasizing audio-visual
evidence and response timing.
Building on these temporal task structures, FastBench focuses on
high-frame-rate-dependent evidence in continuous streams, jointly
evaluating fine-grained perception, historical retention, and
response timing under a bounded visual context.

blocks.en: 2.2 Fine-Grained Motion and High-Frame-Rate Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.2 精细运动和高分率理解

blocks.en:
Fine-grained temporal benchmarks seek to distinguish motion
understanding from reliance on static cues.
TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024 ) uses videos with shared
static content but contrasting temporal properties.
MotionBench ( Hong et al., 2025 ) evaluates fine-grained motion
comprehension and investigates higher-frame-rate inputs and
motion-preserving feature fusion.
FPS-Bench ( Choudhury et al., 2026 ) introduces minimum
frames-per-second (minFPS), using human annotations to identify
the lowest sampling rate needed to verify an answer.
Complementing these efforts, FastBench uses low-FPS answerability
filtering rather than per-question minFPS estimation to evaluate
high-frame-rate-dependent evidence within a causal streaming protocol.

blocks.zh: 2.3 积极主动的认识和流畅的环境管理

blocks.en:
Streaming systems must coordinate response timing, visual
computation, and context retention.
VideoLLM-online ( Chen et al., 2024 ) learns from video streams
to support temporally aligned dialogue.
LION-FS ( Li et al., 2025b ) separates fast response determination
from detail-enhanced generation, while
StreamMind ( Ding et al., 2025 ) uses event-gated LLM invocation
to decouple perception from language reasoning.
VideoChat3 ( Li et al., 2026 ) adapts the spatial resolution of
subsequent windows using predicted interaction states.
For context management, StreamingVLM ( Xu et al., 2026 ) maintains different KV-cache retention windows for visual and
textual tokens, while simpleStream ( Shen et al., 2026 ) demonstrates a strong recent-frame baseline and a
perception–memory trade-off.
In contrast, ProactiveFrame provides a training-free, prompt-driven
baseline that adjusts future temporal sampling rates and uses a
dual-tier window to retain recent high-FPS observations alongside
sparse historical context.

blocks.en: 3 FastBench

blocks.en: In this section, we present the design of FastBench and our baseline framework, ProactiveFrame. We first detail the data curation pipeline in Section 3.1 and present the dataset statistics in Section 3.2 . Finally, Section 3.3 describes the framework and core dynamic perception mechanisms of ProactiveFrame.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了快奔驰的设计以及我们的基线框架"主动Frame". 我们首先详细介绍第3.1节的数据整理流程,并在第3.2节介绍数据集统计数据。 最后,第3.3节描述了主动Frame的框架和核心动态感知机制.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据校正

blocks.en: Raw Video Collection. To construct a diverse pool of candidate videos rich in high-dynamic, fast-paced events across domains such as sports, gaming, nature, and traffic, we introduce an automated, metadata-driven collection pipeline. We first employ a VLM, Gemini-3.1-Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ) , to brainstorm and generate a comprehensive set of search keywords corresponding to our target high-dynamic scenarios. Using these queries, we retrieve raw, untrimmed videos from popular video-sharing platforms, including YouTube and Bilibili. A metadata filter then uses timestamped comments and danmaku to localize high-dynamic segments within the retrieved videos (Appendix A.5 ).
blocks.zh: 原始视频收藏. 为了构建一个多样化的候选视频库,丰富体育、游戏、自然和交通等领域具有高动态、快节奏的活动,我们引入了一个自动化、元数据驱动的收集管道。 我们首先使用一个VLM,双子座-3.1-Pro(Google DeepMind,2026a),来集思广益,并生成一套与我们的目标高能场景相适应的综合搜索关键词. 利用这些查询,我们从包括YouTube和bilibili在内的受欢迎的视频共享平台取回了原始的,未剪接的视频. 然后一个元数据过滤器使用有时间标记的评论和danmaku,在取回的视频(Appendix A.5 .)中将高动态段本地化.

blocks.en: Task Definition. We formulate FastBench as a Streaming Video Question Answering (QA) task over an untrimmed, continuous video stream 𝒱 \mathcal{V} arriving online. At a query timestamp t q t_{q} , a user question Q Q is presented, requiring evidence anchored within a temporal window [ t start , t end ] [t_{\text{start}},t_{\text{end}}] . Following the temporal scopes considered in streaming benchmarks ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , we distinguish three cases: Backward ( t end < t q t_{\text{end}}<t_{q} ), Instant ( t start ≤ t q ≤ t end t_{\text{start}}\leq t_{q}\leq t_{\text{end}} ), and Forward ( t start > t q t_{\text{start}}>t_{q} ). Fig. 2 2(a) illustrates two of these scopes: the backward example requires recalling whether an F1 tire contacted a track feature before the query, whereas the forward example requires observing and counting a kingfisher’s wing flaps after the query.
blocks.zh: 任务定义。 Fast Bench 是一个流视频问答(QA)任务, 在查询时间戳 t q t q q q } 中,呈现了一个用户提问 Q Q , 需要基于时间窗口的证据 [t start, t end] [t_{\text{ start}},t_{\text{end}}]. 根据流线基准(Niu等人,2025年;Lu等人,2026年b)考虑的时间范围,我们区分出三个案例:后向(t end-t_{\text{end-t_{tqq}),即时(t start-t q-t_{\text{start-leq-t_{leq-t_{\ttextd}})和前向(t start-t_{\text{start-t_{t_{q}). 图22(a)说明了这两个范畴:后向例要求回顾F1轮胎是否在查询前接触了音轨特征,而前向例则要求在查询后观察并计算一个捕王的翼襟翼。

blocks.en: FastBench explicitly focuses on the unique difficulties of high-dynamic real-world scenarios. Specifically, the benchmark introduces two primary challenges inherent to continuous perception. First, it requires a significantly finer temporal granularity, demanding models to accurately comprehend rapidly evolving visual information across coherent continuous frames rather than isolated snapshots. Second, it highlights a critical trade-off between retaining a long-term historical context and processing high-frequency visual details. Under a limited context token budget, simultaneously accommodating both aspects becomes a severe bottleneck. Given the continuous visual input and query Q Q , the objective of the model is to effectively navigate this context-granularity trade-off to generate an accurate answer A A .
blocks.zh: Fast Bench明确关注高动态现实世界情景的独特困难. 具体而言,该基准提出了持续认识所固有的两个主要挑战。 首先,它需要一个更精细的时间颗粒性,要求模型能够准确理解通过连贯的连续帧而不是孤立的快照快速变化的视觉信息. 第二,它突出了保留长期历史背景和处理高频视觉细节之间的关键取舍。 在有限的上下文预算下,同时兼顾这两个方面就成为一个严重的瓶颈。 鉴于连续的视觉输入和查询QQ,该模型的目标是有效导航这种上下文-角取舍,生成准确的答案A.

blocks.en: Data Construction Pipeline We designed a comprehensive data construction pipeline that synergizes VLM-driven generation, agentic expert verification, and rigorous human inspection to extract and annotate high-quality question-answering pairs from high-dynamic video streams, as illustrated in Fig. 3 . Initially, raw high-resolution videos are segmented into short clips with a duration of no more than 5 seconds. For each segment, we maintain a multi-stage offline conversation with a Vision-Language Model to automate the annotation process. In this initial phase, the VLM analyzes the native high-frame-rate video clip and proposes a candidate high-FPS QA pair.
blocks.zh: 数据构建管道 我们设计了一个综合数据构建管道,将VLM驱动的生成,代理专家验证,以及严格的人文检查,从高动态视频流中提取和注释出高质量的问答对子,如"图"所说明. 3 (英语). 最初,原始高分辨率视频被分解成短片,长度不超过5秒. 对于每个部分,我们保持一个多阶段的离线对话,与一个Vision-Language Model一起实现注释过程自动化. 在这个初始阶段,VLM分析本土高帧率视频剪辑,并提出了候选高FPSQA对.

blocks.en: To ensure the generated questions genuinely require continuous perception of high-dynamic events rather than static scene understanding, we introduce a low-FPS verification mechanism. The video clip is temporally sub-sampled at a sparse rate of 2 FPS and fed back into the VLM along with the candidate question. If the model can correctly answer the question relying solely on this low-FPS clip, the question is identified as pseudo-dynamic and is immediately dropped from the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 为了确保所产生的问题真正需要持续地了解高动态事件,而不是静态场景理解,我们采用了一种低速感应核查机制。 视频片段在时间上以稀有的2个FPS速率进行分样,并与候选问题一起反馈到VLM. 如果模型能够正确回答问题,仅仅依靠这个低FPS的剪接,问题就被确定为伪动力学,并被立即从管道中掉出.

blocks.en: Questions that successfully pass the low-FPS filter then enter the Vision Expert Verification stage. The VLM first performs temporal grounding to isolate the target action interval and selects the initial frame of this segment. It then generates a text query for the target object, which is processed by SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) to produce a segmentation mask. CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) tracks the resulting points over the video segment and outputs their trajectory coordinates. The VLM verifies or corrects the original answer from these trajectories. Unverifiable or uncorrectable QA pairs are discarded, while the successful ones advance as double-verified QA pairs.
blocks.zh: 成功通过低频过滤器的问题,然后进入远景专家核查阶段。 VLM首先进行时间定位以隔离目标动作间隔并选择此段的初始框架. 然后生成目标对象的文本查询,由SAM3(Carion等,2026年)处理,生成分块口罩. CoTracker3(Karaev等,2025年)在视频段上跟踪所产生的点并输出其轨迹坐标。 VLM从这些轨迹中验证或纠正了原始答案. 无法验证或无法校正的QA对被丢弃,而成功的一对则作为双验证的QA对推进.

blocks.en: Human Verification Double-verified QA pairs are mapped back to their longer source videos and reviewed by ten experts in multimodal video understanding. Each sample undergoes three rounds of inspection comparing the original high-FPS video with its 2-FPS subsample to verify: (1) answer correctness; (2) clear, unambiguous visual evidence and question targets; and (3) dependence on high-dynamic visual information, ruling out questions answerable at 2 FPS or without visual context. Experts also annotate the evidence interval and specific timestamps requiring high-FPS perception. Fig. 2 2(a) illustrates these intervals with Evidence Start and Evidence End markers. Only samples passing all three rounds are retained in FastBench.
blocks.zh: 人类验证双核查的QA对被映射回更长的出处视频,并由十位专家以多模式视频理解方式审查. 每个样本经过三轮检查,将原高FPS视频与其2-FPS子样本相提并论,以验证:(1)回答正确性;(2)清晰清晰的视觉证据和问题目标;(3)依赖高动态视觉信息,排除在2个FPS中回答或没有视觉上下文的问题. 专家还说明了证据间隔和需要高性价比感知的具体时间戳。 图22(a)用证据开始和证据结束标记说明了这些间隔。 只有经过所有三发子弹的样品才保留在快奔克.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据统计

blocks.en: In this section, we present the overall statistics of the FastBench dataset. We first detail the multi-stage data annotation and filtering process. Subsequently, we analyze the dataset’s diversity and comprehensively evaluate its distribution across different capability dimensions and real-world domains. The overall statistical distributions for both capabilities and domains are summarized in Fig. 2 2(b) .
blocks.zh: 本节介绍快奔驰数据集的总体统计数据. 我们首先详细介绍多阶段数据注释和过滤过程。 随后,我们分析数据集的多样性,并全面评估其在不同能力层面和现实世界领域的分布。 图22(b)概述了能力和领域的总体统计分布。

blocks.en: Data Annotation. To construct FastBench, we employed Gemini-3.1-Pro to generate 89 search keywords for high-dynamic scenarios. For each keyword, a VLM semantically filtered the metadata of the top 200 videos ranked by popularity. This pipeline yielded 766 source videos, segmented into 33,619 clips of up to 5 seconds. The VLM then generated 16,702 candidate question-answering (QA) pairs from these high-frame-rate clips. To ensure temporal dependency and mitigate visual hallucinations, low-FPS filtering and Vision Expert Verification reduced the pool to 3,102 double-verified QAs. Finally, multi-round human inspections for answer correctness, visual clarity, and high-dynamic relevance yielded 306 high-quality samples.
blocks.zh: 数据注释. 为了构建快奔驰,我们使用双子座-3.1-Pro生成89个搜索关键字,用于高动力场景. 对于每个关键词,一个VLM精密地过滤了按受欢迎程度排名的前200个视频的元数据. 这个管道产生了766个源视频,被分解为33,619个片段,可长达5秒. VLM随后从这些高帧速率片段产生了16,702个候选问答(QA)对. 为确保时间依赖并缓解视觉幻觉,低度FPS过滤和远景专家核查将电池减少到了3,102个双验证QA. 最后,对答案正确性,视觉清晰度,高动力相关性进行多轮人机检查,获得了306个优质样本.

blocks.en: 3.3 Proactive Frame
blocks.zh: 3.3 主动框架

blocks.en: To resolve the conflict between retaining long-term history and capturing fine-grained temporal details under strict context budgets, we introduce ProactiveFrame, a simple yet effective training-free baseline that enables streaming VLMs to autonomously control their future temporal perception granularity. Instead of passive uniform sampling, the model is guided via text prompts to dynamically switch the frame rate of the incoming stream based on the ongoing streaming context.
blocks.zh: 为了解决在严格上下文预算下保留长期历史和捕捉精细的时间细节之间的冲突,我们引入了 " 积极主动的Frame " ,这是一个简单而有效的无培训基线,它使流出VLM能够自主地控制其未来的时间感知颗粒性。 该模型不是被动的统一取样,而是通过文字提示来引导根据进行中的流环境动态地切换来流的帧率.

blocks.en: Under a fixed context window (e.g., 120 frames), a high frame rate severely compresses the retained history: a 2 FPS stream preserves 60 seconds (sixty 1-second chunks), whereas 30 FPS shrinks the temporal receptive field to merely 4 seconds. To preserve sufficient history while enabling high-dynamic perception, we design a dual-tier context sliding window. As illustrated in Fig. 4 , assuming a default 1080p resolution, the General Window holds a constant 120 frames, within which a higher-tier Focus Window buffers high-FPS chunks for fleeting events. Its size is adjustable; for example, 90 frames accommodate three consecutive high-FPS (e.g., native 30 FPS) chunks.
blocks.zh: 在固定上下文窗口(如120帧)下,高帧率会严重压缩所保留的历史:一出2个FPS流能保存60秒(60分一秒的块),而30个FPS能将时间可接受场缩小到仅4秒. 为了保持足够的历史,同时促成高动力感知,我们设计了双层上下文滑动窗口. 如图4所示,假设默认的1080p分辨率,通用窗口持有120个恒定帧,其中更高层次的焦点窗口缓冲出高FPS块来进行分流事件. 其尺寸可以调整;例如,90帧可容纳相接的3个高FPS(如原生的30个FPS)块.

blocks.en: When the accumulated high-FPS frames exceed the Focus Window’s capacity, the earliest chunk is evicted following a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) principle. Crucially, rather than being discarded, it undergoes graceful temporal degradation: the chunk is down-sampled to a standard low-FPS chunk (e.g., 2 FPS) and enters the lower-tier General Window. This hierarchical management retains a sparse yet continuous long-term history without sacrificing the ability to proactively perceive transient, high-dynamic events.
blocks.zh: 当累积的高FPS框架超过Focus Window的容量时,最早的块会按照FIFO(FIFO)原则被拆出. 关键是,它不会被丢弃,而是受到优雅的时间降解:块被降低到标准的低FPS块(如2 FPS)并进入下级通用窗口. 这种分级管理保留了稀少而持续的长期历史,同时又不牺牲积极主动地认识瞬息万变、高动态事件的能力。

blocks.zh: 表1:Fast Bench的主要评价结果 能力按降序从左到右按样本比例排序。 得分以百分比(%)表示。 绿色或红色括号中的数值表示相对于其各自基准模型的增减。

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Streaming Evaluation Protocol . We follow the streaming inference framework introduced by PhoStream Lu et al. (2026b) , where videos are streamed to the model in 1-second chunks. At each step, the model must decide whether to continue observing or generate a final response. To achieve this, for general (non-streaming) models, we employ explicit text prompts instructing them to output a ”Silent” word if they require more temporal context to answer the query. Conversely, for native streaming models, we preserve their inherent interaction paradigms, evaluating them using their default, model-specific wait tokens to ensure fair and optimal performance. The quality of the final open-ended answers is assessed using an LLM-as-a-Judge.
blocks.zh: 简化评价议定书 我们遵循由PhoStream Lu et al.(2026b)推出的流出推论框架,其中的视频以一秒块的形式流入模型. 在每一个步骤上,模型必须决定是继续观察还是产生最后的响应. 为了实现这一目标,对于一般的(非流化的)模型,我们使用明确的文字提示,如果回答询问需要更多的时间上下文,我们指示它们输出出"静"字. 反之,对于本土流派模式,我们保留了它们固有的相互作用范式,用它们的默认,模型特定的等号来评价它们,以确保公平和最佳的性能. 最终的无限制答复的质量是使用LLM-as-a-Judge来评估的。

blocks.en: Evaluation Criteria Early and late responses are assigned a score of 0. However, high-dynamic real-world streams present a unique challenge: for tasks like short-term counting, models typically cannot react at the exact millisecond an event ends. Instead, they require a brief subsequent observation period to confirm the transition into a static state and ensure the action has fully concluded. To accommodate this natural reasoning process, we adapt the strict evaluation criteria by introducing a relaxed late-response boundary, extending the valid temporal window to 4 seconds after the event concludes.
blocks.zh: 早期和后期答复的评分为0分。 然而,高活性现实世界流带来了独特的挑战:对于短期计数等任务,模型一般不能在某一事件结束的确切毫秒时作出反应. 相反,它们要求随后有一个短暂的观察期,以确认向静态状态的过渡并确保行动完全结束。 为了适应这一自然推理过程,我们调整了严格的评价标准,引入了宽松的后答边界,将有效的时间窗口延长到事件结束后4秒.

blocks.en: Context Window Constraints We define a unified maximum context budget of 248,832,000 pixels, which is equivalent to the information capacity of 120 frames at a 1080p resolution. For our proposed ProactiveFrame, we configure the focus window to 90 frames (at default 1080p resolution) to buffer high-FPS visual chunks, reserving the remaining capacity for at least 30 low-FPS frames to retain a continuous, sparse historical context.
blocks.zh: 上下文窗口限制 我们定义了248,832,000像素的统一最大上下文预算,这相当于在1080p分辨率下120帧的信息容量. 对于我们提出的"主动FRAME",我们将焦点窗口配置为90帧(默认为1080p分辨率)来缓冲高FPS视觉块,保留了至少30个低FPS帧的剩余容量来保留一个连续的,稀少的历史背景.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the main evaluation results on FastBench, revealing a noticeable performance gap between closed-source and open-source models in handling high-dynamic streaming scenarios. Among the evaluated models, Gemini-3.5-Flash achieves the highest overall accuracy within the closed-source category at 50.7%. In the open-source category, JoyAI-VL-Interaction (8B) leads the performance with an overall score of 44.1%. Other open-source models demonstrate more modest capabilities on this challenging benchmark, with Qwen3-VL (8B) scoring 32.9%, Aura achieving 32.1%, and MOSS-VL-Realtime (11B) yielding an overall score of 27.9%.
blocks.zh: 表1介绍了Fast Bench的主要评价结果,揭示了闭源模型和开源模型在处理高动态流场情景方面的显著性能差距。 在被评价的模型中,双子座-3.5-Flash在闭源类中达到最高的总精度为50.7%. 在开源类别中,JoyAI-VL-Interaction(8B)以44.1%的总分领先表现. 其他开源模式显示,在这个具有挑战性的基准上能力更适中,Qwen3-VL(8B)得分32.9%,Aura实现32.1%,MOSS-VL-Realtime(11B)获得27.9%的总分.

blocks.en: Within the scope of proactive perception methods, VideoChat3 (4B) yields a relatively low overall score of 20.7%. This underperformance can likely be attributed to the model’s primary focus on learning to dynamically control the spatial dimension rather than the temporal dimension. Furthermore, its limited 4B parameter capacity inherently restricts its ability to adequately process and reason over highly dynamic, fast-paced visual events.
blocks.zh: 在主动感知方法的范围内,VideoChat3(4B)的总得分相对较低,为20.7%. 这种表现不佳可能归因于模型的主要重点是学习动态控制空间维度而不是时间维度。 此外,其有限的4B参数能力本身就限制了其充分处理和理性的能力,而不能应付高度动态、速度快的视觉事件。

blocks.en: In contrast, our proposed zero-shot approach, ProactiveFrame, demonstrates substantial effectiveness. Integrating ProactiveFrame with the Qwen3-VL (8B) baseline significantly improves the model’s overall performance to 38.3%, representing a notable +5.4% overall increase. This enhancement is driven by massive gains in specific capability breakdowns, highlighted by a remarkable +37.5% surge in the “Streaming & Online” category and an +8.6% increase in “Predictive & Causal” reasoning. Furthermore, combining Gemini-3.5-Flash with our proactive perception method surpasses all other evaluated models, achieving a peak overall score of 52.2%. This configuration also yields impressive sub-category gains, most notably a +11.8% jump in “Entity & Visual” perception and a +10.0% boost in “Streaming & Online” tasks.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,我们提议的零射出办法,即 " 积极主动的Frame " ,显示出实质性的效力。 将主动Frame与Qwen3-VL(8B)基线相结合,使模型的整体性能大幅提升到38.3%,代表着显著的+5.4%的整体增长. 这种增强是在特定能力崩溃方面取得的巨大进展所推动的,突出表现为“立体和在线”类别出现显著的+37.5%的激增,“预测和原因”推理增加+8.6%。 此外,将双子座3.5-闪电法与我们主动感知法相结合,超过了所有其他评估模型,达到52.2%的最高总分。 这种配置还产生令人印象深刻的子类增益,最显著的是“实体和视觉”感知跳出+11.8%,“站立和在线”任务跳出+1.00%。

blocks.en: However, performance drops are also observed in certain sub-categories—for instance, Gemini-3.5-Flash experiences declines in “Motion & Spatiotemp.” (-6.8%) and “Predictive & Causal” (-5.9%), while Qwen3-VL exhibits a minor decrease in the “Instant” temporal scope (-2.2%). This suggests that dynamic temporal resampling can occasionally introduce frame-alignment noise or context redundancy during complex spatio-temporal reasoning. Overall, while these results strongly underscore the immense potential of empowering models with autonomous temporal control, they also reveal that current VLMs’ proactive perception mechanisms still have substantial room for improvement in precision and stability.
blocks.zh: 然而,在某些亚类中也观察到性能下降——例如,双子座-3.5-闪电效应在 " Motion & Spatiotemp " (-6.8%)和 " President & Causal " (-5.9%)中的下降,而Qune3-VL显示 " 即时 " 时间范围略有下降(2.2%)。 这表明,动态时间再模拟在复杂的时空推理中偶尔可以引入帧-对接噪声或上下文冗余. 总体而言,虽然这些结果有力地强调了赋予模型以自主时间控制能力的巨大潜力,但它们也表明,目前的自愿活动控制机制在准确性和稳定性方面仍有很大的改进余地。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 校正分析

blocks.en: Temporal Context Formulation To examine how streaming models utilize temporal context, Table 2 compares three context formulations: (1) Full 30 FPS , processing the stream at its native frame rate; (2) Mixed FPS (Focus) , an oracle that provides 30 FPS chunks only within human-annotated focus intervals ( [ t start , t end ] [t_{\text{start}},t_{\text{end}}] ) and 2 FPS otherwise; and (3) ProactiveFrame , where the model triggers focus sampling autonomously from the visual stream. ProactiveFrame improves over the base models in Table 1 (38.3% vs. 32.9% for Qwen3-VL (8B) and 52.2% vs. 50.7% for Gemini-3.5-Flash), but a gap remains to the Mixed FPS oracle (40.7% and 57.5%), indicating that current VLMs still struggle to trigger focus mode at optimal timestamps.
blocks.zh: 时间背景 为了审查流体模型如何利用时间背景,表2比较了三种上下文配方:(1) 完整的30个FPS, 以原生帧速率处理流体;(2) 混合FPS(焦点),一种只提供30个FPS块的甲骨文,仅在人为附加的焦点间隔内提供([t start, t end] [t_{\ttext{start}},t_{\text{end}}])和另外2个FPS;和(3) 主动Frame, 模型触发器在视觉流中自主地集中采样. 主动 框架比表1的基本模型有所改善(Qwen3-VL(8B)的38.3%对32.9%,双子座-3.5-Flash的52.2%对50.7%),但混合FPS甲骨文(40.7%和57.5%)仍有差距,表明当前VLM仍然在以最佳时间戳来触发焦点模式.

blocks.en: Intriguingly, for Qwen3-VL (8B), Full 30 FPS (42.1%) surpasses the oracle Mixed FPS (40.7%). This reveals a bottleneck in current open-source VLMs: even with perfectly isolated high-FPS focus segments, their fine-grained dynamic understanding remains limited. Consequently, the visual context lost by downsampling background frames outweighs the benefit of longer historical memory.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,对于Qune3-VL(8B),完整的30个FPS(42.1%)超过了甲骨文混合FPS(40.7%). 这揭示了当前开源VLM的一个瓶颈:即使拥有完全孤立的高FPS焦点部分,其精细的动态理解仍然有限. 因此,下取样背景框架失去的视觉环境超过了历史记忆较长的好处。

blocks.en: Temporal scopes further exhibit distinct patterns. On Forward queries, Full 30 FPS exceeds Mixed FPS for both models (56.3% vs. 55.4% on Gemini-3.5-Flash and 42.0% vs. 39.4% on Qwen3-VL). Gemini-3.5-Flash peaks under Full 30 FPS, whereas Qwen3-VL peaks under ProactiveFrame (43.0%). Backward queries peak under the oracle Mixed FPS for both models (55.4% and 40.6%). This aligns with task requirements: Forward queries observe events immediately after the query and therefore benefit from dense frames, while Backward queries must retrieve past evidence and are thus sensitive to the memory–resolution trade-off that the oracle balances best.
blocks.zh: 时间范围进一步显示出不同的模式。 在前方查询中,Full 30 FPS超过混合FPS两种型号(双子座-3.5-Flash上56.3%对55.4%,Qune3-VL上42.0%对39.4%). 双子座-3.5-Flash峰位于Full 30 FPS下,而Quen3-VL峰位于AnoactiveFrame下(43.0%). 在两个型号的甲骨文混合FPS下出现后向查询高峰(55.4%和40.6%). 这符合任务要求: 前置查询在查询后立即观察事件,因此受益于密集的帧,而后置查询则必须取回过去的证据,从而对内存-解析权衡,即甲骨文最能平衡.

blocks.en: Input Video Frame Rate To analyze the effect of temporal granularity, we evaluate Qwen3-VL (8B) at input frame rates from 2 to 30 FPS under a unified context budget (Table 3 ). Performance scales monotonically from the 2 FPS baseline (32.9%) up to 24 FPS, peaking at 44.6% (+11.7%), confirming that dense sampling is essential for capturing rapid state transitions and fleeting motion cues.
blocks.zh: 输入视频 帧率 为了分析时间颗粒性的影响,我们在统一的上下文预算(表3)下,以2至30个FPS的输入帧率对Qune3-VL(8B)进行了评价. 从2个FPS基线(32.9%)到24个FPS的单调性能表,最高达到44.6%(+11.7%),证实密集采样对捕捉快速状态过渡和瞬间运动提示至关重要。

blocks.en: However, native 30 FPS slightly degrades performance to 42.1%. This saturation reflects a core trade-off in context-constrained streaming VLMs: maximal frame rate severely compresses the historical receptive field and introduces substantial inter-frame redundancy, so 24 FPS offers the best balance between context depth and high-frequency detail.
blocks.zh: 然而,本地30个FPS的性能略有下降至42.1%。 这种饱和反应了上下文所约束的流体VLM的核心取舍:最大帧率会严重压缩历史可接受场并引入大量的相框间冗余,因此24个FPS提供了上下文深度和高频细节的最佳平衡.

blocks.en: Capability and scope breakdowns support this observation. Motion-intensive tasks such as Motion & Spatiotemporal Tracking (+13.7%) and Predictive & Causal Reasoning (+14.5%) benefit most, peaking at 24 FPS. Meanwhile, the drop at 30 FPS is most pronounced for Backward queries (46.2% at 24 FPS to 37.5%), since their reliance on historical evidence suffers from the shortened temporal window, whereas Instant queries remain strong at 30 FPS (46.3%), depending mainly on immediate frame resolution.
blocks.zh: 能力和范围细分支持了这一看法。 运动和spatiotemporal Tracking(+13.7%)和President & Causal Reasoning(+14.5%)等运动密集型任务受益最大,达到24个FPS峰值. 同时,30个FPS的下降在后向查询中最为明显(46.2%,24个FPS降至37.5%),因为它们对历史证据的依赖受到时间窗口缩短的影响,而即时查询仍然强劲,为30个FPS(46.3%),主要取决于即时帧分辨率。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced FastBench, a benchmark for evaluating streaming VLMs on high-dynamic real-world streams, built with a trajectory-grounded pipeline that filters pseudo-dynamic questions and verifies answers against SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories before multi-round human inspection. We also presented ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts future frame rates via text tokens and retains history through a dual-tier sliding window. Experiments show that high-dynamic perception remains largely unsolved: the best model reaches only 50.7%, denser sampling helps but is bounded by the granularity–history trade-off, and ProactiveFrame improves over sparse sampling yet trails oracle-guided focusing, indicating that deciding when to look closer is the central open challenge. We hope FastBench and its annotated focus timestamps foster future research on proactive temporal control in streaming video understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了"快奔驰"(Fast Bench),这是在高动力现实世界溪流上评价流出VLM的基准,它用一个轨迹定位的管来过滤伪动力学问题,并在多轮人类检查前对照SAM3和CoTracker3轨迹验证答案. 我们还提出了 " 主动Frame " ,这是一个无培训基线,通过文字符号调整未来帧率,并通过双层滑动窗口保留历史。 实验显示,高动力感知基本上仍未解决:最佳模型只达到50.7%,更密集的采样有帮助,但以颗粒性 — — 历史的取舍为界,而积极主动的Frame改进了零星的采样,但却以甲骨文为导向,这表明决定何时更近看是核心的开放挑战。 我们希望Fast Bench 及其附加说明的焦点时间戳能促进未来在流媒体理解中主动时间控制的研究.

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used Gemini-3.1-Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ) to construct the FastBench question-answer annotations in Figure 3 . It proposed the search keywords used to collect high-dynamic source videos, and then annotated each short high-frame-rate clip: it proposed a candidate question-answer pair, discarded the pair when the question was answerable from a 2 FPS subsample, and otherwise selected the action interval, queried SAM3 for a segmentation mask, and verified or revised the answer against CoTracker3 trajectories. Pairs that could not be verified or corrected were discarded. Gemini-3.5-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) was used to read timestamped comments and danmaku when localizing candidate segments. Every pair retained in the benchmark was afterwards accepted or rejected by human experts. We also used an LLM-as-a-judge to score open-ended answers, following the same protocol as PhoStream ( Lu et al., 2026b ) . We have not used generative AI tools to develop theoretical models, formulate or prove mathematical claims, propose hypotheses, design the method, or translate text. We reviewed the model-generated annotations against the source videos and the trajectory evidence, and human experts made the final decision for every released sample. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including the annotations and evaluation judgments produced with the aid of generative AI.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们使用双子座-3.1-Pro(Google DeepMind,2026a)在图3中构建了快奔克的问答说明. 它提出了用于收集高动态源视频的搜索关键词,然后给每个短高帧速率片段作注释: 它提出了一个候选的问答对子,当问题从2个FPS子样本中解答时丢弃了对子,另外还选择了动作间隔,询问了SAM3的分块口罩,并对照CoTracker3轨迹验证或修改了答案. 无法核实或纠正的对价被放弃。 双子座-3.5-Flash(Google DeepMind,2026b)用于在将候选部分本地化时读取有时间标注的评论和danmaku. 基准中保留的每一对随后都被人类专家接受或拒绝。 我们还使用LLM-as-a-judge来评分开放式答案,遵循与PhoStream(Lu等,2026b.)相同的协议. 我们没有使用基因AI工具来开发理论模型,提出或证明数学主张,提出假设,设计方法,或翻译文字. 我们对照源视频和轨迹证据审查了模型生成的说明,人类专家对每一个发布的样本作出了最后决定。 我们负责这项工作的最后内容,包括在大赦国际的协助下编写的说明和评价判决。

blocks.en: A.5 Metadata Filtering
blocks.zh: A.5 元数据过滤

blocks.en: This subsection details the metadata filter that follows keyword retrieval in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 本分节详述了第3.1节中关键词检索之后的元数据过滤器.

blocks.en: Identifying fleeting, high-dynamic moments within hours of raw video using pure visual processing is computationally prohibitive. However, we empirically observe a strong correlation between specific user engagement patterns and the occurrence of rapid, visually complex events. Notably, timestamped comments (e.g., “01:02 What just flashed by?”) and time-aligned bullet chats frequently highlight moments that capture intense audience attention, serving as natural indicators of high-dynamic scenes. Leveraging this insight, we formulate a VLM-assisted filtering mechanism. We feed the retrieved video metadata—specifically the comments and danmaku—into Gemini-3.5-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) . The VLM acts as an efficient semantic filter, analyzing these textual cues to not only determine the presence of high-dynamic content but also to accurately pinpoint the temporal coordinates of these target segments. This step efficiently prunes the video corpus and extracts precise temporal windows for the subsequent verification stages.
blocks.zh: 使用纯视觉处理的原始视频数小时内识别出瞬间、高动态瞬间,在计算上是令人无法接受的。 然而,我们实证地观察到,具体的用户参与模式与快速和视觉复杂事件的发生之间有着很强的关联。 值得注意的是,时间印上的评论(例如“01:02刚刚闪出什么?”)和时间相通的子弹聊天经常突出吸引了观众强烈关注的时刻,作为高动态场景的自然指标。 利用这种洞察力,我们形成了一个VLM辅助的过滤机制. 我们输入了检索到的视频元数据,特别是评论和Danmaku,输入了双子座3.5-Flash(Google DeepMind,2026b)。 VLM起到高效的语义滤波器的作用,分析这些文字提示,不仅确定高动力含量的存在,而且准确确定这些目标段的时间坐标. 这一步骤有效地检查了录像机,并为随后的核查阶段提取了精确的时间窗口。

blocks.en: A.6 ProactiveFrame Instruction
blocks.zh: A.6 积极主动 框架指令

blocks.en: Figure A.4 shows the instruction used by ProactiveFrame during streaming inference (Section 3.3 ). On each new video chunk, the model answers the active question when the observed context is sufficient; otherwise it emits Focus_Start or Focus_End as the entire response to raise or restore the frame rate of the next chunk, or outputs Silent to keep the current mode.

blocks.en: Figure A.4: Instruction used by ProactiveFrame to control frame rate from the stream itself. Focus_Start requests a higher frame rate for the next chunk, Focus_End returns to normal sampling, and each must be the entire response; Silent continues the current mode when the model should not yet answer.
